bindings: NSMenu/NSMenuItem supply the entire native menu implementation. A native NSMenu subclass adds application model availability for submenu items; leaf targets delegate availability/execution through opaque application command IDs.

NSApplication setMainMenu and NSMenu display/close own the detached root. AppKit selects native key equivalents before field editor commands. Existing host event conversion supplies physical key preferences.

Actual NSMenuDidBeginTracking/DidEndTracking notifications delimit the embedding pump scope. The native loop retains its event queue; the caller can process its descriptors without stealing queued native menu events.
Private editor backing windows reject window ordering except order-out, preventing normal native menu key-window restoration from mapping an extra widget.
remaining: Browser menu-model extraction, transport, idle owner-loop command dispatch and complete application/toolkit menu qualification.
